name: indo_afro_motivational
note: Motivational Indo-Afro Fusion: Driving 12/8 cross-rhythms combining West African Djembe/Shekere with Indian Tabla/Tihai mathematics, soaring Raga Bhupali melodies (Sa Re Ga Pa Dha) on Sitar and Bansuri, punchy syncopated Afrobeat bassline, and triumphant cinematic brass and strings.
sources: Ethnomusicological research on West African 12/8 bell & djembe polyrhythms merged with Hindustani Tala & Dadra
Melodic bridge: Shared pentatonic framework of Raga Bhupali (C D E G A) and West African pentatonic
Motivational cinematic scoring standards: 112-120 BPM driving pulse, ascending melodic arcs, call-and-response, and dynamic build to an anthemic climax
